macros.name: scAliasRoom
macros.doc: Sets ⟨alias⟩ as a replacement name for ⟨room⟩.

macros.name: scConfig
macros.doc: This command can be used to set all keys mentioned in Section 3.1, except for room, shape, rows, and seats per row, after the seatingchart environment has begun.

macros.name: scConfigScheme
macros.doc: Sets keys just like the optional argument of \scSeatingScheme, but does not assign seats.

macros.name: scDeclareRoom
macros.doc: A new room layout is created for the room ⟨room name⟩.

macros.name: scGenerateSeatingList
macros.doc: Creates a CSV file ⟨output file⟩ containing the labels of the assigned seats, one per line.

macros.name: scLoadSeatingList
macros.doc: The command imports labels from ⟨input file⟩ and automatically changes the label format to l, so that the imported text is shown on its seat.

macros.name: scRemoveSeatAt
macros.doc: Removes seat ⟨seat number⟩ in row ⟨row⟩ from the layout.

macros.name: scRemoveSeats
macros.doc: Removes all seats listed in the comma-separated ⟨list⟩, where each entry is of the form {⟨row⟩,⟨seat number⟩}.

macros.name: scSetAisle
macros.doc: Inserts an aisle at the position of ⟨seat number⟩ through all rows.
